### STA 4222 — Sample Survey Design {.unanchored}

<div class="course-university">University of South Florida</div>

Topics include principles of sample survey design, probability sampling,
estimation, and practical methods for collecting and analyzing survey data.

<div class="course-tags">
<span>Survey Sampling</span>
<span>Sampling Design</span>
<span>Estimation</span>
</div>

### STA 4102 — Methods for Applied Statistics {.unanchored}

<div class="course-university">University of South Florida</div>

Applied statistical methods with emphasis on statistical analysis,
interpretation of results, and applications to real-world data.
